description: See how much of your RawModels subscription is left, next to your Codex and Claude limits in one BB usage card. Shows the rolling 5-hour window and the monthly output-token allowance, each with its reset time. Reuses the login the pi coding agent already has, and the key stays on your machine. Requires a RawModels subscription and pi with the @rawmodels/pi package signed in on the machine that runs your threads.
